verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents real code execution in two places. Computer can write and execute code in an interactive Linux sandbox with Python, Node and Unix tools (docs-17/18), and the Agent API's `sandbox` tool runs real code in an isolated container and uses the output in the answer (docs-33). Together these cover the computed-answers part of the story. Labs is only vaguely described as bringing reports and projects to life (docs-10). One hands-on report says Computer often fails to trigger or stalls (comm-7), which lowers confidence but doesn't concretely contradict code execution. Missing for 10: evidence of analyzing user-uploaded data, chart generation, downloadable file outputs, and independent corroboration that code execution works reliably.
